**27 July 2026, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM**
Training Room, DOST-ASTI, Diliman, Quezon City

This site hosts all materials for the one-day training on Agentic AI, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol: hands-on notebooks, lecture decks, and exercise solutions.
